title: Semantic resolution
prompt: Implement `static string TypeOfExpression(string source)`: parse the source (a single statement or expression), get the SemanticModel from a CSharpCompilation, find the first InvocationExpressionSyntax, and return the fully-qualified type name of its resolved method's ContainingType, or "?" when it does not resolve.

tests.name: resolution
tests.hint: compilation.GetSemanticModel(tree); symbol = model.GetSymbolInfo(invocation).Symbol as IMethodSymbol; use symbol.ContainingType.ToDisplayString().
